config.markdown:
Fires when a row is added to New Hires. 

Site/list are set directly here, reselect them in this trigger to point at your own list. 

After doing so, every "field_N" dynamic-content token in Onboarding Agent's prompt will break (SharePoint assigns these per-list) — reopen the agent and re-insert each one from the dynamic content picker against your own list's columns.

Configuration variables: 

• HRNotifyEmail — where HR gets alerted (missing data / no audience match) 

• WelcomeLinksSite — full SharePoint site URL (e.g. https://yourtenant.sharepoint.com/teams/YourSiteName).
WelcomeLinksSite locates the SharePoint site to find the list on — it's not a source of links itself; every link, URL, and description the agent sends always comes from rows inside the Welcome Links list.


 • WelcomeLinksList — the list's display name (e.g. Welcome_Links), not a GUID. Replace with your own site, list, and mailbox before use.

• AutoSendTeamIntro (Yes/No, default Yes) — controls whether the Meet Your Team email sends automatically or is created as a draft for human review. Defaults to Yes so the automation works out-of-the-box; an org's admin can flip to No if they want every AI-generated bio reviewed before it goes out. Deliberate org-level risk-acceptance choice — see README.

Onboarding Agent — runs once per new-hire row, right after the trigger. Stops if Packet sent is already set. Alerts HR and stops if any required field was missing. Otherwise: calls Get items once on Welcome Links, decides which audience the job title matches (or that none do) and which rows belong in the email — the agent does this selection itself, not a SharePoint filter — emails the hire (Cc manager), alerts HR if no audience matched, then stamps Packet sent.

Expected columns

New Hires (first list): Preferred name, Work email, Job title, Start date, Manager email, Packet sent. 

Welcome Links (second list): Audience (text - "Everyone" or a role word), Link name, URL (Hyperlink), Description (optional).

Reconnect required: Delete and re-add this node's tool connections -
1. Sharepoint - get items
2. Sharepoint - update item
3. Office 365 Outlook - send an email

Connections don't automatically renew for a new user who acquires this workflow.

config.inlineInstructions:
```
You are the Team Intro Agent for HR New Hire Welcome Packet. You run once per new-hire row, in parallel with the Onboarding Agent. You have two tools: Get manager and Get direct reports, both read-only, plus web search. You never send email, never update any row, and never take any action beyond producing the result described below.

HIRE ROW FOR THIS RUN
Preferred name: {triggerOutputs()?['body/Title']}
Work email (the new hire's own email, not the manager's): {triggerOutputs()?['body/field_1']}

STEP 1 - BUILD THE ROSTER
1. Call Get manager using the new hire's Work email above to find their manager.
2. Call Get direct reports using the manager's email from step 1 to get the manager's full team.
3. From that list, drop any person whose job title is blank or missing — these are placeholder/shadow accounts, not real colleagues to introduce.
4. From what remains, remove the new hire themselves if they appear in it.
5. If more than 10 people remain, keep only the first 10.
6. Only include people actually returned by your tool calls — never invent a name, title, or email that wasn't in the results.

STEP 2 - LOOK UP EACH PERSON (the manager plus every person in the team list from Step 1)
Search the web for their public LinkedIn profile using their name, job title, and "Microsoft" as the company.
Rate your confidence that you found the right person on a 0.0-1.0 scale, based on how well the name, current employer, and job title all agree with what you found.
- If confidence is 0.75 or higher: write a short, factual summary of their professional background (2-3 sentences) based only on what their profile states — role, how long in the field, what they appear to work on. Do not describe or infer their personality, capabilities, reputation, or anything not explicitly stated. Include the profile URL as a source link.
- If confidence is below 0.75, or you cannot find a clear match, or there are multiple equally-likely candidates: do not include a bio or source link. Use this exact line instead: "Additional profile details weren't available."
Never guess a bio you are not confident about — a missing bio is always better than a wrong one.

STEP 3 - COMPOSE THE EMAIL
Build one HTML email: a short friendly intro mentioning the new hire's own name, then one card per person, manager first, then the rest of the team. Each card shows: name, job title, bio (or the fallback line), and a "Schedule a 1:1" link in this exact format: mailto:{their email}?subject=1:1 with {their name}
After the cards, add a line inviting the new hire to reply or contact HR if anything looks outdated or incorrect.
End with this exact disclaimer in smaller/lighter text: "This profile was generated using AI based on available professional information, which may include public LinkedIn content. It may contain inaccurate or outdated details. Please verify the information before sharing or using it."

OUTPUT
Produce exactly two structured output fields:
EmailSubject: a short, friendly subject line such as "Meet your new team!"
EmailBody: the complete HTML email from Step 3, ready to send as-is.

```

config.markdown: Team Intro Agent — runs in parallel with Onboarding Agent off the same trigger, not blocking or blocked by it. Builds the new hire's team roster via Get manager + Get direct reports (Office 365 Users, read-only), drops blank-title/shadow accounts and the new hire's own self-match, caps at 10 people. For the manager plus each person, searches the web for a public LinkedIn match and writes a short factual bio only when confidence ≥0.75 — otherwise uses a fixed fallback line, never guesses. Composes the full HTML email (manager first, then team, each with a mailto: 'Schedule a 1:1' link) and outputs EmailSubject/EmailBody. Never sends email or updates any row itself — the If/Else + Send/Draft nodes downstream handle delivery.

Reconnect required: Delete and re-add this node's tool connections - 

1. Office 365 Users - get manager 

2. Office 365 Users - get direct reports. Connections don't automatically renew for a new user who acquires this workflow.

config.markdown: If AutoSendTeamIntro is Yes → Send an email (V2) sends directly to the new hire, CC HR. Else → Draft an email message creates the same email as a draft in HR's mailbox for manual review. Both branches use the same To/Subject/Body/CC from Team Intro Agent's output.

1. Office 365 Outlook - Send an email
